title: IM60019: Dynamic Probabilistic Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Markov Models: The basic Markov process, Flow-graph analysis of Markov
processes, Transient Markov processes, Markov process statistics, Recurrent
events and random walks, Time-varying Markov processes.
Semi-Markov and Decision Models: Discrete-time and continuous semi-Markov
processes, Reward structures, sequential decision processes and dynamic
programming solutions, Value and Policy iteration in semi-Markov decision
processes.
Ref.: Dynamic Probabilistic Systems, Vol. I and Vol. II, Ronald A. Howard, John
Wiley and Sons, Inc., 1971.
